lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, organized into approximately five observable horizontal rows extending towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a distinct rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges running along the upper flank; the primary ridge exhibits a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal aspect to low-luminance shadow pixels on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs distributed across the first dorsal fin surface, showing higher spatial density and smaller diameter near the anterior base, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs towards the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of micro-scale high-luminance spots on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit compared to the macro-spotting on the lateral flank.
